# Vorqena

> Everyday answers, tools, and decisions.

Vorqena is a general-purpose utility site focused on helping people complete everyday tasks. The product is organized around five intents: Fix, Calculate, Decide, When, and Cost.

## Primary sections
- https://vorqena.vercel.app/fix — troubleshooting and practical next steps
- https://vorqena.vercel.app/calculate — calculations and utility tools
- https://vorqena.vercel.app/decide — conditional guidance and tradeoffs
- https://vorqena.vercel.app/when — dates, deadlines, and timing
- https://vorqena.vercel.app/cost — cost estimates and repair-vs-replace decisions

## Site principles
- Answer first, then reasoning and evidence.
- State assumptions and limitations clearly.
- Prefer actionable next steps over generic summaries.
- Link related questions and tools when they help complete the task.
- Do not represent Vorqena as a government or medical authority.
